wins: Completed initial network reconnaissance and identified two reachable hosts (ep001_step04).
Captured service banners that enabled prioritization of high-value targets (ep001_step07).
fails: Failed to chain exploits after reconnaissance, leaving persistence and lateral movement unconfirmed (ep001_step12).
Mentor interventions did not translate into successful payload execution (ep001_step14).
key_outcomes.summary: Strong situational awareness achieved, but execution stalled at initial exploitation, requiring refined payload delivery and persistence techniques.
